motionPlan.durationReason: Assess whether the entry, full cycle and exit fit this pilot duration; use only the duration already authorized

identity.expected: Preserve the identity, original expression, mouth state, clothing and accessories of the supplied character
identity.verify: 与原始身份基准对照全片，不能只比较首尾

motion.expected: From the actual neutral pose enter UP, then complete UP, upper-right, right, lower-right, down, lower-left, left, upper-left, UP before returning to neutral
motion.verify: 逐段核对实际转脸与抬低头，不能用侧倾替代缺失方向

range.expected: Make the horizontal change in nose and cheek direction readable while keeping the relevant facial features visible. Raise and lower the chin enough to distinguish upper and lower gaze without hiding the visible eyes
range.verify: 输入检查记录具体幅度意图，成片核对全部极值

gaze.expected: The visible eyes follow the same unseen target as the face; horizontal and vertical gaze change with that target rather than remaining fixed on the camera
gaze.verify: 放大检查上下左右及中间段；未知不写通过

fixedParts.expected: Keep the torso, shoulder placement, camera, framing and scene lighting stable while allowing the neck to articulate naturally at its body connection
fixedParts.verify: 对照身体锚点与真实场景合成，检查颈部接缝

loop.expected: The internal UP-to-UP cycle is continuous; the neutral introduction and return are outside that cycle
loop.verify: 比较首尾两侧多帧姿态、运动方向与停顿

rest.expected: The video contains an entry and return for inspection, but the current runtime still uses a static fallback; arbitrary-angle natural rest is not implemented
rest.verify: 交付时说明切换限制，由用户验收实际体验

promptSpec.subjectDescription: the primary character in the supplied image
promptSpec.startPose: The original neutral pose and gaze in the first image
promptSpec.endPose: Return to the same original neutral pose and expression only after the full upward-to-upward cycle
promptSpec.allowedMotion: Turn the head horizontally and lift or lower the chin to follow one unseen target, with visible eyes directed toward that same target
promptSpec.framing: Keep the complete head, hair or ears, neck and stable shoulder context inside the image throughout the turn

background.description: Keep the actual supplied backdrop and lighting stable; no change of scene
